title: Stroke: history or residual deficits
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's past stroke and any residual deficits.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for history of stroke.

HPI
Pt is a 56-year-old female presenting for routine follow-up after a previous ischemic stroke. Pt reports feeling well and denies any new symptoms or concerns. She is here for monitoring and continued management of her history.

Medication List
- Aspirin 81mg daily
- Atorvastatin 40mg daily

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 98% on RA.
Neuro: Alert and oriented x3. Speech clear. Facial symmetry intact. Motor strength 5/5 throughout. Coordination and gait normal. No residual deficits noted.

Assessment
1. History of ischemic stroke. Pt is stable and asymptomatic at this time.

Plan
1. Continue current medications.
2. Routine follow-up in 6 months.
3. Pt advised to seek immediate care for any sudden neurological changes.

Electronically signed,
D. Kowalski, MD
10/14/2026
explanations: A past ischemic stroke with no residual deficits: Z86.73, personal history (no HCC). I63 codes are for the acute stroke only.

distractors.why: I63 codes are for the acute stroke episode; after discharge use Z86.73 or I69.-.
No residual deficit is documented, so there is no sequela to code.
